case.title: Murder
case.other:
At about 7:30.p.m. on Sunday 18 December 2016, an attack took place at a lift lobby at No. 452 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City. The victim of the attack was subsequently certified dead on 19 December 2016. The following two Chinese males are wanted by Police in connection with this case:

Wanted Person (1): KWOK Yau-man, alias Ka Shu / Ah Ka, born on 10 November 1970, now 55 years old, Hong Kong Identity Card No. C649XXX(X), about 1.7m tall, short curly hair, medium build.

Wanted Person (2): LAU Ho-yin, alias Ho Yin, born on 30 May 1976, now 50 years old, Hong Kong Identity Card No. K538XXX(X), about 1.85m tall, short hair, fat build.

Photographs of the wanted persons are shown at left. Any member of the public who has information relating to the crime or information about the whereabouts of the culprit(s) is requested to contact the Police without delay.

A reward of four hundred thousand Hong Kong dollars ($400,000-HK) is being offered by Police.

The reward will be paid, either in full or pro-rata, to a member of the public, or apportioned amongst members of the public, giving information within the period specified in this notice leading to the arrest and satisfactory prosecution of the culprit(s). For the purpose of the reward, “satisfactory prosecution” shall mean that the arrested person(s) is/are found to have a case to answer in cases in Magistrates’ Courts, District Court or Court of First Instance of the High Court of Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

case.title: Indecent Assault on Girl under 16 and Rape
case.other:
At about 3 p.m. on Wednesday 14 September 2005, a 13-year-old girl was indecently assaulted by the landlord of her flat when she was alone at home in Shanghai Street, Mongkok. At about 2 p.m. on Tuesday 18 October and Wednesday 19 October 2005, the landlord used a key and a screwdriver to gain entry to the flat. He forced the victim to drink some green liquid which made her dizzy and then raped her.

A Chinese male LAU Ping-fai, born in June 1945, now aged 80, HK Identity Card No. G354XXX (X), about 1.6m tall, medium build, short hair, last known address in Mongkok, is wanted by Police in connection with this case.

Photograph of the wanted person is shown at left.

case.title: Murder
case.other:
At about 3:52 a.m. on Tuesday 4 August 2009, the deceased, male LEE Tai-lung, aged 41, was knocked down by a silver 7-seater vehicle outside Shangri-La Hotel at 64 Mody Road, Tsimshatsui, Kowloon. Three culprits, wearing baseball caps, facemasks and armed with knives, alighted from the said car and chopped the male before they returned to the car. At the same time, another green private car also arrived to join the 7-seater vehicle. Both vehicles then sped off. The male was later certified dead at the hospital. Both vehicles, confirmed to be stolen, were later found damaged by fire at Kau Liu Ha, Lam Kam Road, Tai Po, New Territories.

The following two persons are wanted by Police in connection with this case :

Wanted Person No. 1 : Male NG Yik-tung, alias NG-Tung, now aged 38, Hong Kong Identity Card No.: Z823XXX(X), about 1.72m tall.

Wanted Person No. 2 : Male SO Kai-man, alias SO-Kai, now aged 38, Hong Kong Identity Card No.: Z869XXX(X), about 1.76m tall, strong build.

Any member of the public who has information related to the crime or information about the whereabouts of the wanted persons shall contact Police without delay.

A reward of four hundred thousand Hong Kong dollars ($400,000-HK) is being offered by Police.

The reward will be paid, either in full or pro-rata, to a member of the public, or apportioned amongst members of the public, giving information within the period specified in this notice leading to the arrest and satisfactory prosecution of the culprit(s). For the purpose of the reward, “satisfactory prosecution” shall mean that the arrested person(s) is/are found to have a case to answer in cases in Magistrates’ Courts, District Court or Court of First Instance of the High Court of Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

Police identified seven culprits and later arrested six of them. The following culprit is still wanted by Police in connection with the case :

Wanted Person : Male CHAN Fok-ching, alias Ah Ching, born in September 1977, now aged 48, Hong Kong Identity Card No.K721XXX(X).
